messages:
sanjay: FYI vendor just flagged a staggered delivery for the H100 batch — partial hold in FRA due to a thermal packing inspection failure. 18 units cleared, 6 held. vendor_ops_bot created ticket V-9932.

elaine: Ugh. Any DOA count in the arrived 18?

sanjay: yes — 4 DOA out of the 18. Vendor is proposing either immediate air-replacement for the 4 (extra expedite fee) or a consolidated sea shipment in 10 days with complimentary credit.

mike: What does that mean for our Dedicated pools next week? I have scheduled jobs requiring 16 H100s in eu-west1 on Mon.

sanjay: If we accept consolidated sea, we lose 4 units for ~2 weeks. Air replace gets them in 2-3 days but +$15k expedite and customs brokerage.

lisa: Who's handling customs? HS code / tariff class might be the blocker in FRA. If we can reclassify as "repair parts" we might avoid duty. I can run it with our broker.

elaine: Also need serials for the DOA units to open RMA. @sanjay can you paste them?

sanjay: Serial list below (from vendor manifest):
```\nAWB: DE1234567890\nSERIALS: H100-AX12-9981, H100-AX12-9982, H100-AX12-9983, H100-AX12-9984\n```

vendor_ops_bot: Ticket V-9932 updated by vendor: "Air replacement quoted. ETA 48-72h if accepted. Can bundle expedite with insurance waiver (vendor pays partial)."

tom: Cost tradeoff calc — if expedite = +$15k, lost revenue from 2-week delay for 4 units (estimated) = ~$28k (based on committed customer workloads). So air looks cheaper.

mike: Confirmed. If we lose 4 H100s, some can be backfilled from our APAC spare pool but relocation adds lead time and risk. Do we have 6 available in APAC now?

elaine: APAC pool currently has 7 free H100s but they'd take ~5 days to transfer and clear customs. Not ideal.

lisa: Broker says we can attempt "repair parts" HS reclassification but requires vendor paperwork and depot sign-off — won't be same-day.

sanjay: Proposal: accept vendor air replace for the 4 DOA, vendor covers 50% expedite cost, we cover brokerage and import VAT. We'll also open RMA for the DOA units for traceability. Elaine, can you open RMA with vendor (attach serials) and confirm paperwork for HS reclass in the meantime?

elaine: On it. Opening RMA now and tagging finance for expedite cost approval.

vendor_ops_bot: RMA request created: RMA-5741. Vendor escalated to "airreplace" queue.

tom: Finance — can we pre-approve up to $10k expedite cost without CFO sign? Otherwise air replace might be delayed.

mike: Ops decision: proceed with air replace if vendor covers >=40%. If they cover only 0-30%, we fallback to APAC backfill. 

sanjay: I'll negotiate vendor to 50% share. Also asking them to include inspection photos and packing temperature logs for the held 6 — need root cause for the thermal failure.

lisa: Please also request vendor to provide commercial invoice with "repair/return" wording to support HS reclass.

elaine: RMA-5741 updated with serials and invoice request. Marking priority: high.

sanjay: tagging @vendor_ops_bot to track ETA and once air AWB is confirmed drop into #eng-infra for staging planning. :shipit:

vendor_ops_bot: Air AWB provisionally available: AWB DE9876543210, ETA EU arrival 2026-03-25 08:00 CET pending customs release.
